actionable_findings: MG1–MG8: one SCC selector and I/O owner; ordered axis/button records; coalesce displacement only at drain; sticky loss, drop stale prefix, cancel, rebaseline, suppress held input; exactly-once foreground delivery independent of saturating counters.
First useful slice is a host drain into existing pointer and window owners before MMIO. MP1–MP12 are temporary planned cases, not repository IDs.
Detectable software loss is owner-visible. Hidden latch transitions are not recoverable and set no flag. Masking and publication need a later MC68000 contract.
blockers: M1–M7 each stay partial or open: programming, polarity, vector conflict, simultaneity, part applicability, and unmeasured cost.
Live Mac loop remains mask 7 with VIA delivery disabled. No interrupt or shutdown binding. 2009 SCC notes are not model or 1984 proof.
decisions_needed: Later MC68000 contract for masks, critical sections, and memory publication.
Separate MMIO contract for addresses, spacing, ack, reset, IUS, and master enable.

worker_input.identity_note: Existing runner reports normalized UTF8/LF prompt bytes/hash;frozen file is deterministic UTF8/CRLF. Both identities recorded;normalized contents unchanged.

decisions.lead_result: Bound capture only;no rendering/allocation/callback in interrupt path.

One SCC selector/I/O owner also owns relevant VIA reads. PB reads can clear CB1/CB2 flags under current PCR mode;do not promise unrelated flag preservation or reuse startup writes as a shared-driver contract.
Preserve every accepted normalized record in order. Reject displacement coalescing:clamping and drag paths are nonlinear,even without intervening button changes.

Sticky detectable loss discards unread prefix and calls existing owner cancel. Rebaseline never creates a press;held left remains suppressed until a later released observation,not any arbitrary edge. Hidden hardware loss has no guaranteed flag.

Deliver each committed record once through cs_window_input_sample;cancel through cs_window_input_cancel. Do not directly call pointer/window leaves or duplicate counter/cursor composition. On owner fault retain prefix and stop;no auto-replay/repair.

Quiescent begin and bounded stop barriers;never publish a partial record. Stop ends admission and abandons undelivered records,cancels once if owner ready,retains diagnostics. Later begin cannot replay. Exact masks/publication/epoch exhaustion need the concrete contract.
Fixed caller-owned storage and bounded stack;exact layout/capacity and measurements remain prerequisites,not claimed128K fit.

First next slice:freeze an original pure capture/drain API and fixed limits,then sequential synthetic tests/native68000+x64 object checks before MMIO. Current intake creates no API/code/fixtures or test execution.

Input/latch and PB side effects reviewed;current isolated profile understood. Shared VIA ownership/flags and cross-chip coherence remain.
VIA0x64/SCC0x68/combined0x6C vector table corroborated;earlier prose disagreement retained. Actual CPU mask/vector/entry-save/RTE/reentry/start-stop contract remains.
Coalescing/hidden-transition and cross-chip sampling limitations identified. No valid latency bound or all-edge guarantee.
Ordered bounded capture,sticky visible-loss/cancel and one foreground owner selected;no code or concurrency proof.
2009 family documentation distinguishes NMOS/CMOS/ESCC;does not prove a particular1984 part,Snow model or physical board.

planned_cases.requirement: Quiescent begin admits no record and performs no MMIO.
One accepted normalized X record reaches the existing input owner once.
One accepted normalized Y record reaches the existing input owner once.
Motion/press/motion/release order is preserved;no button sampled from a later record.
Boundary reversal remains two records:atx0,-1then+1 endsx1;coalescedzero would endx0. Include dragged-window clamp path.
Capacity overflow sets sticky detectable loss;unread prefix is discarded and owner cancel occurs once.
Rebaseline with held left stays suppressed;only a fresh released observation permits a later press.
Pre-baseline/stopped records never cross into a new session;generation exhaustion cannot wrap into replay.
Saturated diagnostic counters do not suppress or duplicate valid delivery.
Owner refusal/fault retains its diagnostic prefix;no requeue,auto-repair or leaf-call retry.
Stop at publication boundaries exposes no partial record,ends admission and retains diagnostic state.
Marked uncertainty takes cancellation path;hidden even-edge collapse cannot be claimed detected. Synthetic interleavings are not hardware timing proof.
